final: WITH groups AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM all_star AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM groups) SELECT g.player_id, g.bats, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / t.total_count AS share FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
